newsitem.title: UK: Britain's main advertising body launches Website.
newsitem.headline: Britain's main advertising body launches Website.

text.p: Britain's main advertising industry body said on Friday it had launched a Website on the Internet to tell the world what it did and to offer direct links with member organisations.
The Advertising Association's new site says the principal goal of the AA is "promoting and protecting the freedom to advertise".

The Website describes the AA's activities, which include tracking draft legislation that could restrict or otherwise affect Britain's 10-billion-pound advertising industry and organise campaigns against restrictions.
The AA closely follows advertising-related debates in Britain and around Europe on subjects like tobacco, alcohol and food, and advertising to children.
The new Website -- located at http://www.adassoc.org.uk/aa on the Internet's World Wide Web -- also lists publications and "executive briefs" published by the AA.
The Association is a federation of 27 trade associations and professional bodies representing advertisers, ad agencies, the media and support services.
